name: maestro-ablate
description: Maestro: Ablate measures which sections of a SKILL.md are load-bearing and rebuilds the skill without the rest.

interface.shortDescription: Cut skills down to what is load-bearing
interface.longDescription: Install Maestro: Ablate to inventory your skills, audit a SKILL.md against a written rubric, and run a measured ablation loop that proves which sections a skill actually needs before anything is cut.
defaultPrompt: Use /ablate to rank my skills by how much context they cost.
Use /ablate to audit this SKILL.md and show me the diff before anything is written.
Use /ablate to measure which sections of this skill are load-bearing.
